message:
Last summer, we had a surprise power outage during a big family movie night. Just as the popcorn was popping, the lights went out, and my phone was down to 5%! Talk about bad timing! 

I scrambled for my trusty power bank, which saved the day and kept my phone charged so we could still use it for fun games and music. It’s funny how we often forget how much we rely on our gadgets until they’re on the fritz. 

Now, I make sure to keep my power bank ready for any unexpected moments. How about you? What’s your go-to trick for staying connected during a blackout?
